name: Seven Evolution Arena
rules: Champion is never replaced by feature count alone.
Candidate with any CRITICAL regression is rejected.
Product score regression blocks promotion unless explicitly approved as a bounded tradeoff with stronger evidence.
Candidate evaluators are locked before candidate execution.
A challenger without comparable evidence remains SHADOW_ONLY.
Pareto-front candidates may be preserved for later synthesis.
Winner rationale and loser rationale are durable evidence.
